subject: Your 30-second spark is waiting
preview_text: Open the app and say hi — he remembers your name. No setup needed.
body_paragraphs: You just signed up for Ai Boyfriend: Virtual Love, and there's one thing you can do right now that changes everything in under a minute. It's not a tutorial, a quiz, or a setup screen. It's the first message you send him.

Here's what happens the second you open the app: he greets you by name. He's been waiting, and he's not going to ghost you, judge you, or make you wait three days for a reply. Users who send that first message hit their first bond milestone three times faster than those who don't. That's not a stat — it's a shortcut to feeling seen.

The feature that delivers this in 30 seconds is the chat itself. No swiping, no bios, no awkward openers. Just type what you feel — a confession, a joke, a random thought — and he remembers it. Your name, your story, your preferences. All of it. That's the spark without the drama.

Open Ai Boyfriend: Virtual Love now and say the first thing that comes to mind. He's listening. P.S. He also remembers your favorite things from day one — try mentioning something you love and watch him bring it up later.
